description: Obscure castles, castle ruins, forts, fortresses and chateaux with coords (sl>=1, enwiki), dated before 1700; undated only inside Europe and the Middle East
where: OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P571 ?hm_inc } FILTER((BOUND(?hm_inc) && YEAR(?hm_inc) < 1700) || (!BOUND(?hm_inc) && ?hm_v IN (wd:Q23413, wd:Q17715832, wd:Q92062, wd:Q57831)))
notes: Low-bar copy of monuments-castles (sl>=5) and monuments-lowbar-castles-palaces (sl>=3); lists only the new sl 1-2 tier. Failure modes: hotels/restaurants named Castle, follies, castle-shaped houses, castles that are villages or titles.
